A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel approach for data selection for semi supervised acoustic modeling.
the proposed method can be used to construct training sets for semi-supervised training of large scale ASR systems, which can be used for a variety of applications.
the proposed method is a simple, yet powerful way of selecting training data, which is robust against errors in the hypothesized transcripts, while still retaining a high degree of confidence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed constraint can be used to control the distribution of the selected data, which is a useful property when training acoustic models for large vocabulary tasks such as Voice Search.
the selection of training data should not only focus on the quality of the hypothesized transcriptions, but also on the quality of context dependent state matching.
a simple data selection strategy based on a context dependent state constraint is sufficient to obtain a data set that is competitive with random selection of high confident utterances.
